basis: W4-002 and W4-003; full wave-3 baseline.
status: Proposed cases with accepted priority direction from W4-004 through W4-011. Variation links do not credit every verb or prove a capability.

groups.title: Guarded edits and operational evidence
groups.case: Use existing guards and independent result checks in each selected workflow. Exercise stale targets, partial results, selection preservation, and the stated inverse.
groups.limit: D54 removes mandatory agent reversal. Retain targeting, validation, independent result evidence, and partial-effect reporting; selected sessions may simplify recovery-only machinery. Existing runtime behavior is unchanged here.

groups.title: Basic track structure
groups.case: Create, identify, name, arm, and organize the tracks used by the song.
groups.limit: Current track existence and naming are product paths. Arm, active state, and colour are in the track-state group.

groups.title: Notes, clips, MIDI files, and timeline
groups.case: Import material, edit notes and loops, place song sections, and edit the automation needed by those sections.
groups.limit: Existing Launcher/MIDI product paths do not prove exact Arranger writes or every automation curve. Required verbs and fields must be named.

groups.title: Devices and ordinary composition
groups.case: Build and change a stock/plugin chain; use layers or drum pads where the task requires them.
groups.limit: Existing scoped product paths count. Opaque plugin state and all container types are not implied.

groups.title: Place samples and obtain audio output
groups.case: V05/06 edit audio clips and device samples. V07/R03 investigates quick inaudible post-device/pre-fader readback from an existing clip over its full span or a measure/two.
groups.limit: Insertion and historical master capture do not prove full CRUD, device sample reads, or track bounce. Recording and final export are generally operator tasks.

groups.title: Save and reuse results
groups.case: Use operator save/export by default. Add automated save or preset export only when a selected case needs it.
groups.limit: Project save and preset export are source leads with distinct proof needs. General cross-project reuse is not a main-path gate.

groups.title: Mix controls and routing
groups.case: Balance tracks, create the Effect track a send needs, use returns, route the required signals, and operate the master path.
groups.limit: A stereo balance does not prove input/output routing or send modes. Current mixer proof is narrower than this proposed case. Of track.group-effect, only Effect-track creation is in V12; Group and Hybrid creation and grouping remain bonus work.

groups.title: Session and performance variation
groups.case: Add live launches, scene actions, groove, or performance recording only when easy or directly needed.
groups.limit: This row group mixes verbs. A low live-control priority does not justify using Launcher recording as exact Arranger editing. Tempo, meter, and cue markers have their own groups.

groups.title: Expressive MIDI and timing variation
groups.case: Use V02 and R02 to audit timing/expression fields and reproduce pressure independently. Prepare upstream evidence if an API defect is confirmed.
groups.limit: Pressure has no demonstrated workaround. Each field requires its own verdict; support for MIDI channels alone is not full MPE support.

groups.title: Existing audio content variation
groups.case: Inspect an existing audio clip and identify its file, range, and required properties before editing or reuse.
groups.limit: No matching read path was found in the pinned survey. Sample insertion does not supply this capability.

groups.title: Nested structures and wider reach
groups.case: Promote only the nested device reach needed by a selected variation; otherwise retain as bonus work.
groups.limit: Source limits remain. A flat or small project does not establish wider reach or scale. Effect-track creation moved to mix-routing; Group and Hybrid tracks stay bonus work.

groups.title: Sound state and performance mappings
groups.case: Use V08/09 and R04 to add useful remote controls and modulation. Inspect external live setters and prove each selected field independently.
groups.limit: Accepted preset paths are part of the union. New live replacements, all types, all payloads, and arbitrary plugin state are not established.

groups.title: Grid instrument construction
groups.case: Build a useful Grid instrument, change values/cables/mappings, and reopen it; select relocation and other flavours when needed.
groups.limit: Phase 11 retains ownership. Scoped research is demonstrated potential. Wave-two setters and broader families still have gaps.

groups.title: Host discovery and required internal reads
groups.case: Find an intended Bitwig device, plug-in, or preset by name and inspect only the internal objects required by the selected operation. V01 resolves at least one name; R05 probes the popup browser for custom locations.
groups.limit: Arbitrary internal introspection is not required for a song. Descriptor access is a route, not proof of every field or verb. E101 found the browser content-type write ineffective; R05 is a bounded re-probe, not an established route.

groups.title: Optional clip-file interchange
groups.case: Import a .bwclip only if real source material requires that format; compare its usable notes and metadata.
groups.limit: Current external extraction is heuristic source evidence. This is not preset authoring and was not automatically deprioritized.

groups.title: Offline preset and Grid authoring
groups.case: Create or change reusable files without a running host if that output is selected later.
groups.limit: Some codec predicates passed offline; broader edits and donor-free extraction are not proved. Live operations do not automatically deliver an offline API.

groups.title: Upgrade support and reference retrieval
groups.case: Keep existing admission and required guards. Plan broader client support, degradation checks, and reference retrieval as later work unless they block a selected case.
groups.limit: Grid admission exists within scope. Primary-only degradation and Bitwig manual retrieval remain distinct work, not effects of a successful creative example.

groups.title: Analysis and cross-project library meaning
groups.case: Use Ghostworks or another consumer through explicit file/result handoffs when the task needs interpretation or library records.
groups.limit: These are intentional external responsibilities. Minimal media identity and timing facts remain in Ghostnote. Source/claim labels do not establish provider quality.

groups.title: Unproved internal and DSP breadth
groups.case: Select a bounded part only if a concrete creative task needs it.
groups.limit: Grid resources, arrays, larger bounds, and DSP image deployment are not collectively demonstrated potential. No universal DSP/audio guarantee is implied.

groups.title: Physical-unit and rare sound state
groups.case: Use physical-unit control only when it makes a selected sound task work; do not require general parameter conversion.
groups.limit: Existing controls remain usable. Wider device-state coverage is a bonus.

groups.title: Audio resources within devices
groups.case: V06 assigns externally sliced hits to Samplers on pads; read/retrieve, replace, or clear sample sources and set only required region/playback fields.
groups.limit: A preset resource model does not prove live sample CRUD. MP-9 must be split by field and route.

groups.title: Tempo, meter, and timeline position
groups.case: V03 reads and sets the tempo, meter, and position that arrangement edits need.
groups.limit: Only the tempo, meter, and position verbs of this row are in V03. Play/stop, loop, metronome, and record stay low priority under W4-009. W4-D needs a verb-level row for this split.

groups.title: Cue markers as song-section markers
groups.case: V03 may read and create cue markers for the sections it arranges.
groups.limit: Optional scope. Two external implementations have source routes; none is proved in Ghostnote. A marker is navigation, not an Arranger edit.

groups.title: Track arm, active state, and colour
groups.case: V12 sets the track fields the mix uses, such as colour or active state.
groups.limit: Only the fields the mix needs; SM-1 has source leads and no live proof. Arm is a recording control and stays low priority.

groups.title: Drum pads and Sampler slots
groups.case: V06 creates or uses the drum pads and Sampler slots that hold externally sliced hits.
groups.limit: Only the Drum Machine pad and Sampler subset of DP-4 is in V06. Other container and slot types remain bonus work.
